narrative: On the board. First light in the upper chamber. Gib is on Field's Holinshed, and that book is shut under him. The forty leaves lie beside him, shut. On the board. The foot of the last leaf, the rule dry. Nothing is written under it. No clean sheet is on the board. The cat has not moved. On the board. Brooke is on the shelf, shut. Golding is in the room, shut, and the cat is not on it. The coffer is shut, both locks.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the ruled line and left it.
